terms.comment: Our description for a development cycle. cursus, cursūs m. — course or progression; ēlabōrātiō, ēlabōrātiōnis f. — elaboration or working out. The phrase’s computing sense is a semantic extension; it is not claimed to be a standardized technical equivalent. The noun supplies both ē- and -bōr-.

sources: Lewis & Short: cursus · Lewis & Short: elaboratio
